observed_webs.name: The AI web
observed_webs.question_answered: What does an answer engine see?

capabilities.name: One-shot observation
capabilities.description: Observe a domain once, across all three webs, and return the full report synchronously.
capabilities.determinism: same input state produces same output

pricing.human_readable: First 3 reports/month per domain: free. After that: €4.90 per report.

capabilities.name: Permanent observation
capabilities.description: Observe a domain continuously. The domain is re-observed on a schedule; the caller is notified when a signal changes state or the global score moves beyond a threshold.

threshold.description: notify when global score moves by at least this many points

pricing.human_readable: €1.90/mo per monitored domain (monthly interval), €4.90/mo (weekly), €9.90/mo (daily). Cancel any time.

capabilities.status_note: Scheduled execution runs via Cloudflare Cron Trigger; see /observe.

capabilities.name: Compare two observations
capabilities.description: Return the deterministic delta between a baseline observation and a current one — which signals changed, in which direction, with the evidence for each.

capabilities.name: Explain a signal
capabilities.description: Return the evidence behind a single signal verdict — what was fetched, what was found, and why the rule produced that result.

capabilities.name: List the signal catalogue
capabilities.description: Return the full catalogue of signals, grouped by dimension and by web, with weights.

contains: signal catalogue grouped by dimension and web

a2a_invocation.note: Read-only. Any A2A client, including automated auditors, may invoke this skill to verify the declared contract is real without side effects.

artifact_provenance_contract.provenance: Every artifact carries the observationId it was produced from and the target URL fetched; the audit report additionally lists, per signal, the exact evidence source used to reach that verdict.
artifact_provenance_contract.integrity: Public evidence files served under this domain are hashed in proof.json / ai-proof.json (SHA-256 integrity manifest).

cancellation_and_resume_contract.cancel: obs.permanent subscriptions can be cancelled at any time via the a2a skill obs_permanent with action:'cancel' and the subscriptionId.
cancellation_and_resume_contract.resume: A cancelled subscription is not auto-resumed; call obs.permanent again with the same url to re-register a new subscription. In-flight one-shot observations (obs.one_shot) are synchronous and short-lived, so they are not cancellable or resumable mid-flight.

guarantees: Evidence-based: every verdict traces to a fetched resource.
Deterministic: no score is produced by a language model.
Honest gaps: unverifiable signals are returned as not_applicable, never as failures.
Non-invasive: only publicly served resources are fetched; no authentication is attempted.
not_guaranteed: A ranking, citation or commercial outcome in any third-party AI system.
Completeness where a target site blocks automated access.
